name: St. Croix Valley Foundation Environmental Grant Program
summary: Spring-cycle grants for nonprofits in the St. Croix Valley (Minnesota and Wisconsin) that protect and restore habitat, land, water and wildlife or connect people to nature, as general operating or program support. Large-scale restoration and capital costs are excluded.

geography.label: Chisago and Washington counties (MN); Burnett, Polk, Pierce and St. Croix counties (WI)

amount.note: USD 5,000-25,000 for general operating support; USD 500-10,000 for program support.

eligibility.rule: Is an eligible tax-exempt entity or partners with an eligible fiscal agent
For operating support, be based in the six counties and have the environment core to mission and programs
Requests no funding for capital expenses or endowments
Not a science, research or large-scale restoration project
Submits only one application to the programme

applicant_types.quote: Be a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, government, tribal, educational, or religious entity

geography.quote: Serve communities in one or more of the Foundation's six counties: Chisago, Washington (MN); Burnett, Polk, Pierce, St. Croix (WI)

access.quote: If you're working to protect, restore, or connect people to the environment in the St. Croix Valley-we invite you to apply.

amount.quote: $5,000-$25,000 for General Operating Support (for organizations with the environment at the core of their mission) $500-$10,000 for Program Support

fiscal_sponsor.quote: Applicant must be a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization; a governmental entity, tribal entity, educational or religious organization defined as tax exempt; or partner with an eligible fiscal agent.

eligibility.quote: Applicant must be a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization; a governmental entity, tribal entity, educational or religious organization defined as tax exempt; or partner with an eligible fiscal agent.

Organizations with the Environment at the core of their mission and programs may apply for General Operating Support (grant range: $5,000-$25,000). o Applicants must be located in the SCVF six-county service area (Chisago and Washington counties in MN and Burnett, Polk, St. Croix, and Pierce counties in WI).
Funding is not available for individuals, capital expenses, endowments, or large-scale restoration projects.
Requests to fund science, research, or large-scale restoration projects.
Please note, organizations are limited to one application to the Environmental Grant Program.
